title: I will play in the Big 3 This Summer, says God Shammgod
htmlContent: [caption id="attachment_502951" align="alignnone" width="4096"] Dallas Sports Fanatic[/caption] Last week I released a report that former Washington Wizard guard and Dallas Maverick assistant coach God Shammgod according to a Big 3 league source is interested in playing in the league this summer. Well,  recently I spoke with Shammgod about his interest in possibly joining the Big﻿ 3 "I have talked to [Ice] Cube and told him I want to play when The Big 3 comes to Dallas this summer," Shammgod told me. The Big 3 have already announced that they have signed Al Jefferson, Gilbert Arenas, Jason Terry, Joe Johnson, Josh Smith, Mario Chalmers, Brandon Rush, Shannon Brown, Lamar Odom, Steve Blake, and Kendrick Perkins. Nancy Lieberman and Power are looking to repeat as Big 3 champions this season, but they will have some stiff competition with the new additions coming in this season. We will have to see how this upcoming season turns out. God Shammgod played 20 games with the Washington Wizards during the 1997-1998 season. He would later go to dazzle audiences around the world with his famous crossover known simply as "The Shammgod."
